name: Cliveden Gold Walking Trail
summary: National Trust's circular trail, about 5 km, from Woodland car park, Cliveden.
notes: Route line from OpenStreetMap, built on the date shown. Nobody from Driftway has walked it, so surfaces and barriers are as mapped, not as found.

The trail is National Trust's. Check their page on the day for opening times, parking, livestock and conditions: https://www.nationaltrust.org.uk/visit/oxfordshire-buckinghamshire-berkshire/cliveden/cliveden-gold-walking-trail
National Trust suggests about 1 h 30 to 2 h.
